$comentario: Blocos de estilo enviados ao modelo de imagens. Em inglês porque a maioria dos modelos responde melhor; edite livremente.
base: authentic pixel art sprite, dark fantasy RPG, hand-placed pixels, crisp 1px outline, limited palette of at most {max_cores} colors, deliberate color clusters, selective light from the top-left, strong readable silhouette, centered, single subject, plain flat solid #FF00FF magenta background, front or three-quarter view
negativo: anti-aliasing, blur, soft edges, gradients, smooth shading, photorealistic, 3d render, painterly, noise, grain, dithering noise, jpeg artifacts, text, watermark, signature, frame, border, cropped, multiple subjects, drop shadow, glow halo

categorias.monstro: creature design: {descricao}. Single full-body creature with a distinctive silhouette and one clear focal point (eyes or weapon). Material callouts: {materiais}.
categorias.arma: equipment item: {descricao}. Shown on a clean diagonal (bottom-left to top-right), hilt to tip, no hand, no character. Material callouts: {materiais}.
categorias.icone: game icon / collectible: {descricao}. Compact object centered with a bold silhouette readable at 32px. Rarity mood: {raridade}.

raridades.raro: slightly richer tones with a small steel-blue accent
raridades.muitoRaro: confident jewel tones with one glowing accent
raridades.epico: ornate details, arcane purple glow accent, rim light
raridades.lendario: radiant gold and ember accents, intricate silhouette, aura of power
